Class TUI

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.GameUI
org.adsl.client.view.tui.TUI
public class TUI extends GameUI
Text User Interface driven by an event queue and a state/visitor pattern. Server callbacks (network thread) enqueue events into a thread-safe queue. Key presses are translated by toInputEvent(Key) and dispatched immediately in the main loop. In both cases the current TUIScreen receives the event via event.accept(screen) and returns the next screen (same instance = stay, new instance = transition). Disconnection is handled outside the visitor: onServerDisconnected() is called directly by AppCoordinator and runs a dedicated disconnect flow without involving the screen state machine.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Initializes the terminal, shows the connecting screen, requests a connection to the server and runs the main event loop until exit. On any unhandled exception, shows a fatal error screen, then shuts down the terminal and exits the JVM.
      Specified by:
      start in class GameUI

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Stops the main loop and closes the terminal, restoring the original shell state. Safe to call even if start() failed before the terminal was created.
      Specified by:
      shutdown in class GameUI

    • transitionTo

      public boolean transitionTo(TUIScreen screen)
      Calls TUIScreen.onEnter() on screen and follows any redirect chain returned (each onEnter may return another screen to jump to). Returns true on success, false if a fatal error occurred.

    • dispatch

      public void dispatch(ServerEvent event)
      Enqueues a server event for processing on the main loop thread. Called from the network callback thread.
      Specified by:

    • onServerDisconnected

      public void onServerDisconnected()
      Enqueues a DisconnectedEvent so that the screen state machine handles the disconnection through the normal visitor flow. The ping scheduler is stopped to avoid repeated disconnection events.
      Overrides:
